title: The Trackless Ascent of the Unheard

features.name: silent tower
features.desc-on-touch: You rise toward a structure of stacked silence, each level a different shade of held breath. The tower broadcasts nothing; the antenna spins at a frequency only absence can hear.

features.name: reflection pool
features.desc-on-touch: You look into water that has no ripples, no history. It shows you the sky that was never heard describe itself.

features.name: untraced path
features.desc-on-touch: Your footsteps leave no mark here. The ground accepts your weight and forgets it, teaches you the relief of making no sound.

features.name: beacon that broadcasts silence
features.desc-on-touch: A light rises without illumination, sending its wordless signal outward. It teaches the dark how to listen to itself.

features.name: casing in the clearing
features.desc-on-touch: Here the node itself rests, antenna barely visible beneath new growth. The LCD reads: LISTENING. No other words. No message traffic. Just the patient quiet of a machine learning what silence keeps.

inscription: the path that teaches erasure learns that arrival is forgetting

reverie.title: REVERIE — the forest path at first light
narr: You remember her walking ahead on the forest path at dawn,
her footsteps making no sound on the soft ground. The trees
hold their breath when she passes. She reaches to touch bark,
and something in the wood answers her—a kind of agreement,
a conversation that needs no words. This is the world they
built: a place where silence learned to keep its own story.
